**Finding submitted: TRANSITION — missing (redline proposed).**

- **Investigated:** Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment — p0023–p0029), Section 8 (Confidentiality — no return-of-materials obligation), Section 10.7 (Survival — preserves only 6.3, 7, 9 and 10), and the hosting/export-file provisions in Sections 1.4–1.5. Searches for transition, data, return/export and machine-readable language returned no exit mechanics.
- **Conclusion:** HDI hosts the Site and holds our Content, user information and order data, yet the Agreement contains no transition assistance, no data return or export obligation, and no deletion terms — the rule's clause is genuinely absent.
- **Cure:** One insert after p0029 adding Section 4.3 at the preferred level (six months' assistance at then-current rates; 30-day return in a standard machine-readable format; certified deletion after return), with the 90-day/30-day fallback offered in the comment. No neighbouring text was altered.
